name: Design Plastics Inc
old_description: Design Plastics Inc. specializes in high-quality vacuum forming and rotary thermoforming (multi-station machine), providing precision-engineered solutions to industry leaders in the areas of aerospace, automotive, agricultural, governmental, medical, retail, and industrial manufacturing.
about:
Design Plastics Inc was founded in 1972 in Omaha, Nebraska, as a custom thermoforming business leveraging in-house tooling expertise. The company is now part of Coda Resources LTD.

The company provides custom injection molding, vacuum forming, and rotary thermoforming, supported by engineering and tooling services. Its injection molding presses range from 55 to 730 tons, and its thermoforming equipment handles sheets up to 5 feet by 9 feet and thicknesses from 0.080 to 0.50 inches. After forming, 3-axis and 6-axis CNC machines perform trimming. Operations run from two Nebraska facilities in Omaha and Blair, serving prototype through high-volume production.

Design Plastics serves OEMs in aerospace, automotive, agricultural, governmental, medical, retail, and industrial manufacturing sectors across the United States and international markets.

The company emphasizes its dual-process capability—injection molding and vacuum forming under one roof—allowing engineers to guide customers to the optimal process and remain involved through production. It highlights U.S.-based manufacturing, an ISO 9001-certified quality system, and sustainability initiatives including wind turbines and recycling.
